svg.aria-label: Each EU law by the number of obligations it places on companies and the number of companies naming it in an annual report. The GDPR, the AI Act, DORA and the platform laws are widely named; large product laws such as the Machinery Regulation, the Toys Safety Regulation and the Radio Equipment Directive are never named.
